search_companies.description: Find an accepted company by its ticker or name; returns exact company identifiers.

find_metrics.description: Find definitions and explicit metric codes; use companies to scope company-specific aliases.

get_series.description:
Read exact values. periods uses normalized keys (2024-FY, 2024-Q2, ASOF:2024-12-31).
        Omitted periods returns available history. revisions is current or all_verified.
        If ambiguous, select returned variant IDs. Missing rows mean no data, never zero.

get_coverage.description:
List available periods and update dates. Explicit periods also return missing cells.
        Without explicit periods this does not infer an issuer's required reporting schedule.

get_evidence.description:
Read saved document metadata or verified formula input lineage using source_id from a value.
        Never fetches originals, reads local source documents, or claims a new document verification.
